cards.title: Loss of Human Connection Biggest Threat to Kids, Not AI
cards.body: A pediatrician argues that screens aren't destroying children's connections—lack of open conversation is. The solution is spending more time talking with kids, not restricting technology.

cards.title: Making Halloween Magic for Your Kids This Year
cards.body: A parent explores how Halloween traditions create moments of connection and wonder for families. Celebrating autumn through pumpkins and costumes becomes a meaningful shared experience.

cards.title: When Your Child Wants to Know About Their Donor
cards.body: Donor conception anxieties belong to parents, not children. Your child needs parents interested in them exactly as they are, without projecting adult concerns.

cards.title: Free-Range Parenting Conviction Raises Autonomy Questions
cards.body: A mother's conviction for allowing unsupervised play sparks debate about children's independence. The case highlights tensions between safety concerns and developmental needs.

cards.title: Twin Identity: Learning to Grow Apart Respectfully
cards.body: Twins must learn not to share everything automatically as they develop individual identities. Respecting personal boundaries is a crucial developmental value for multiples.

cards.title: Is Your Adult Child in Crisis or Are You Too Anxious?
cards.body: Anxious parents of struggling adult children should pause before the next rescue attempt. Ask yourself crucial questions about whose needs you're actually addressing.

cards.title: Ending Corridor Care in Hospitals for Children
cards.body: England's health secretary prioritizes ending corridor care for children as part of winter preparations. The NHS is investing £140m in urgent care improvements.
